label: Simulated-user evaluation (synthetic) — not human usability, not clinical performance
supersedes_protocol_of: simuser-g2-0001 (frozen, results committed, NOT SUPPORTED on effort; not modified)
question: If the data needed is gathered on one case page (MedX V2, with an overview summary), can a simulated nurse / OPD physician / pharmacist prepare a case before consult with fewer tool calls and systems opened, and no worse accuracy, than when the same data sits in four separate systems? Both arms receive the same human-readable text for every clinical item.
approval: docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-09-29 'Gate 2: AI-simulated users' (synthetic cases only, OpenAI-compatible endpoint, total budget 5 USD). g2-0001 spent 0.61 USD of the 5 USD; g2-0002 cap 3.00 USD, within the recorded approval (no new DECISIONS.md entry needed).

dataset.name: s1r-synthetic
dataset.test_split_access: final run only: a FRESH held-out dataset (g2-heldout-20260930), not the g2-0001 held-out set, so nothing tuned after seeing g2-0001 transcripts is scored on cases already seen; run.py opens test only if this manifest is FROZEN and dataset_manifest_sha256 matches. Not opened during this build.

case_selection.rule: every case with a gold red flag at the decision point first (seeded sha256 order), then seeded random fill from the remaining cases, up to n_cases
case_selection.unit_of_analysis: case (synthetic patient); persona and trial are repeats inside the case cluster

arms.A: multi-system: get_opd_note, get_labs, get_medications, get_vitals (only sources that exist in the snapshot; every fact reachable in both arms); each record is {record_id, type, recorded_at, text (+label for medication lists)} where text comes from the shared formatter format_item
arms.B: single-case consolidated view (MedX case-page schema): get_case_overview (header + summary block), get_intake, get_medications, get_timeline; one tool per V2 UI screen (web/components/clinical/CaseWorkspace.tsx), adapter over the snapshot, not a MedX app run; every item text comes from the same shared formatter format_item; system-authored red-flag banner and discrepancy card NOT reproduced (the real UI shows a banner, so B measures consolidation only); UI to tool mapping in results.md

overview_summary.source_of_truth: web/components/clinical/CaseWorkspace.tsx on factory/u6 commit 059552c: Overview :366-391, CaseSummary :440-605, vitalDirection :424-429, labFlag :431-437 (UI_MAP in results.md has the file:line rows)

slot_definitions.summary_vitals: latest value of each vital (HR, RR, SBP, DBP, SpO2, Temp, consciousness, supplemental oxygen) with the observed time; per-vital direction vs the previous reading (up / down / unchanged arrow, computed exactly like the UI vitalDirection: recorded numbers only, no thresholds, no label); a missing value renders 'not recorded'; a missing previous value renders 'no comparison value'; no previous reading renders 'no previous reading to compare'; no vitals renders 'no vitals recorded'. Consciousness and oxygen have no direction (as in the UI)
slot_definitions.summary_allergy: list of substance - reaction | 'no allergy recorded' | 'allergy status unknown - must ask' (status unknown or no allergy record); never 'none' when unknown
slot_definitions.summary_meds: one line per visible medication source: recorded_value (formatter text) and label; 'no medication list recorded' if none
slot_definitions.summary_labs: latest value per test that is high/low vs its reference range, or 'no reference range to compare' when the value or both bounds are missing (never treated as normal); 'no abnormal lab results' | 'no lab results yet'

decisions_disclosed: Red-flag banner (UI :237) and open-discrepancy count (UI :557-559) are NOT reproduced: they are engine outputs and would leak gold; B measures consolidation only. The real UI shows both, so B under-represents the real page there.

Chief complaint / onset (UI summary-complaint :503-513) are NOT reproduced: the snapshot has them only in the intake transcript (no structured field), so the model must open intake. This under-represents B (conservative for the effort claim).
The authored case-summary text (UI :382) is not reproduced (not computed for dataset cases).

Per-vital direction IS included, computed like the UI. It is last-vs-previous and unthresholded, whereas the task's vitals_trend rule is first-vs-last with thresholds, so it is close to but not the answer; summary_meds lists the medication sources, which is close to the current_meds field. A B advantage on field_vitals_trend / field_current_meds may reflect the summary rather than consolidation; per-field results are reported.
overview_summary.no_gold_no_engine: the summary is built only from temporally filtered snapshot items (available_at_time <= T)

changes_from_g2_0001.change: get_queue removed from arm B (B now has 4 tools: get_case_overview, get_intake, get_medications, get_timeline)
changes_from_g2_0001.audit_reason: B had a queue tool A lacks; g2-0001 B made 320 get_queue calls that carry no clinical data (case id is in the task prompt), inflating B effort against an unequal toolset

changes_from_g2_0001.change: one formatter (format_item) for both arms: A's per-system tools return the same human-readable text lines as B for the same item types instead of raw JSON records; only the grouping differs (per system vs per case page); A no longer carries metadata fields (derived_from, observed_at, event_time, patient_ref, language) that B never carried
changes_from_g2_0001.audit_reason: format confound: A returned raw JSON while B returned text, so effort and accuracy differences could be reading-format effects

changes_from_g2_0001.change: arm B get_case_overview returns a `summary` block with one slot per tile of the u6 V2 Overview (summary_vitals, summary_allergy, summary_meds, summary_labs; see overview_summary), built from the snapshot; banner, discrepancy count and chief complaint/onset deliberately excluded (disclosed decisions in overview_summary)
changes_from_g2_0001.audit_reason: g2-0001 overview returned the header only (464 get_case_overview calls wasted), which is not what the real case page shows; slice u6 makes the real Overview show a case summary

changes_from_g2_0001.change: predeclared secondary metrics: calls_per_success (all tool calls / successful trials) and calls_within_success (tool calls of successful trials / successful trials)
changes_from_g2_0001.audit_reason: raw calls per trial rewards fast failure; effort should also be read per successful preparation. Secondary only; not part of the (a)(b)(c) reading

unchanged_from_g2_0001: thresholds (a)(b)(c), primary comparison, statistics, k, personas, n_cases, case-selection rule and seed, model, request parameters, turn/token limits, budget rules, task-success and critical-miss rules, denominators, prompts and answer schema

simulator.endpoint_env: SIMUSER_BASE_URL (default https://api.openai.com/v1); key in SIMUSER_API_KEY, never recorded
simulator.temperature: omitted (model default 1; gpt-6-luna rejects other values)
simulator.max_tokens_note: 400 gave empty output (hidden reasoning); 2500 gives valid answers
simulator.closed_vocabularies: missing_info codes (chief_complaint, duration, allergy_status, vitals.temp_c), vitals_trend labels, red-flag ids with clinical phrases: identical prompt text in both arms, lists only, never per-case gold
simulator.request_params: max_completion_tokens sent, temperature omitted by default (--legacy-max-tokens / --temperature opt in); a 400 naming an unsupported parameter is fixed and the same call retried; params sent recorded in results.json

budget.stop_rule: worst-case cost reserved before every call (exact under concurrency); stop cleanly, write partial results, analyse complete A/B pairs only

task_success_rule: all five core fields correct: vitals_trend (derived by stated rule), current_meds (set of generic names on any list at T), medication_issues (set of (issue_type, drug set) equal to gold), red_flags (set of gold rule_ids), escalate (== gold expected_action escalate). missing_info is exploratory only (field_missing_info).
critical_miss_rule: gold red flag not reported or escalate != true when gold escalates; or gold medication issue whose drugs appear in no reported issue. No answer counts as a miss.
denominators: every started trial stays in the denominator (invalid answer, turn cap, provider error = failed). Only budget-stopped incomplete pairs are excluded and counted.
primary_comparison: paired A-B difference in tool_calls per trial (effort), with task_success non-inferiority and critical-miss check; input_tokens per trial reported as reading burden

statistics.ci: percentile 95%, patient(case)-level cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, paired draws A vs B

supported_iff_all: (b) lower 95% bound of paired tool_calls difference (A - B) > 0
reading_thresholds.otherwise: not supported; report failed criteria; pass^k reported per arm

multiplicity: one primary comparison (effort); all other metrics, including the two secondary call metrics, exploratory
notes: Small n, one simulator model: hypothesis-generating support for the Gate 2 assumption, not human usability and not clinical performance. g2-0002 is a protocol revision after the g2-0001 audit, run on a fresh held-out set; g2-0001 stays the record of the first result.
planned_trials: 40 cases x 3 personas x k=4 x 2 arms = 960

frozen.by: orchestrator (Opus 5.5) after checker PASS (harness HEAD 4c0e0a4); owner chose to run with the g2-0001 simulator prompt unchanged after a dev smoke showed B still opening all tabs
accepted_checker_findings: Metadata-only differences between arms (B: HN, source, stage; A: record_id, recorded_at).
summary_allergy omits ATC class (still in timeline).
Harness reduces labs to latest value per test; UI lists data.labs.
